steps: Buy a new heat-pump clothes dryer (at least 4.4 cu. ft., ENERGY STAR) by December 31, 2026.
Install it at your ComEd service address and keep the itemized sales receipt.
Submit the official ComEd 2026 appliance rebate application within 60 days of purchase (or by February 28, 2027, whichever is earlier).
After approval, your $200 rebate check arrives in approximately four weeks.
